catalog.description: Water, liquid water or steam, H2O.
Carbon dioxide gas, CO2, the gas exhaled in respiration.
Glucose, grape sugar or dextrose, C6H12O6.
Sodium bicarbonate, baking soda or sodium hydrogen carbonate, NaHCO3.
Acetic acid or ethanoic acid, the acid in vinegar, C2H4O2.
Sodium acetate or sodium ethanoate, C2H3NaO2.
Sodium carbonate or washing soda, Na2CO3.
Calcium carbonate, limestone or chalk, CaCO3.
Calcium hydroxide or slaked lime, CaH2O2 (expanded atom counts of Ca(OH)2).
Sodium chloride or table salt, NaCl.
Hydrogen chloride or hydrochloric acid, HCl.
Sodium hydroxide or caustic soda, NaOH.

warning: Symbolic classroom equations only. Atom conservation does not establish whether a reaction occurs, its mechanism, yield, energy, conditions or safety. No experiment procedures, concentrations or mixing quantities. Fixed neutral formula catalog; no ions, charge balance, hydrates or state symbols. Every source is preserved. Held and blocked equations are never released as balanced.
